title: All about MUNI, a platform turning online conversations into real-world action
summary: MUNI, launched by Rappler in 2026, is a digital space where verified information and trusted voices are given prominence – an antidote to opaque algorithms that have turned social media platforms…

blocks.text: In September 2026, Rappler launched MUNI, a community platform that aims to carve out a corner of the internet that can still do good.

With AI slop, disinformation, deepfakes, uncontrolled AI scraping, and opaque algorithms turning off many from the internet of today, Rappler envisioned an alternative digital space where facts dominate feeds and people can more easily find trusted voices and trustworthy information with which to make decisions.
MUNI is that space. It comes from the Filipino word “muni-muni,” which means to reflect or think deeply. It is also at the heart of the word “community,” which is what the platform aims to build.

MUNI is a digital space, accessible on both mobile and desktop devices, where you can find various public and private chat rooms run by civil society groups, community leaders, journalists, and institutions.

Unlike other social media platforms where anyone can create a chat room, MUNI gives prominence to trusted voices and groups that all agree to only share facts and verified information. Groups on MUNI abide by a constitution and set of community guidelines that enforce this. Leaders in these groups are given green shield badges beside their usernames to help people on MUNI identify them.

blocks.caption: All about MUNI, a platform turning online conversations into real-world action

blocks.text: MUNI, as a platform, is accessible through multiple platforms, not just one app or website. Participating groups in MUNI can put MUNI on their websites or apps. Rappler, for instance, has a MUNI tab on our free app (download it here). The concept is that MUNI is one corridor, reachable through many doors. Or one corridor through which you can enter many doors, many communities.

It’s built on the Matrix Protocol, a digital infrastructure for decentralized and secure communications. It prioritizes privacy and security, and is end-to-end encrypted like Signal and Telegram. But it provides an additional layer of protection because of its decentralized nature, which makes it less vulnerable to surveillance or attacks compared to a centralized system. Also, unlike Telegram or Signal that requires a phone number to create an account, you can communicate with the Matrix Protocol with just a username.
Download the Rappler app for free from the App Store or Google Play Store. Once inside the app, tap the MUNI tab at the bottom of your screen to explore communities and chat rooms.
MUNI is also visible on the websites of newsgroups like Daily Guardian, an Iloilo-based news outlet, and SunStar Cebu, a newsroom based in Cebu, among others.
Muni gives you or your organization more than just another communication channel. It’s a space to bring people together, strengthen relationships, and turn shared interests into meaningful action.
Here’s what you can do:

items: Build your community. Bring your members, supporters, and audiences together in one dedicated space where they can connect, interact, and feel more involved in your organization’s work.
Share updates. Keep your community informed about your latest news, activities, announcements, events, and initiatives. Make sure the people who matter to your organization stay in the loop.
Start conversations. Encourage meaningful discussions, exchange ideas, ask questions, and gather feedback. Allow your community to participate and make their voices heard.

Expand your reach. Connect with people beyond your existing network. Through Muni’s growing community of organizations and individuals, you can introduce your work to new audiences and build valuable connections.

Share knowledge. Give your community easier access to relevant stories, trusted information, and expert voices. Help them stay informed about the issues and interests that matter to your organization.

Encourage action. Bring your advocacies and initiatives closer to the people who care. Share volunteer opportunities, calls for participation, and community activities that turn shared goals into real-world action.

Grow beyond your own network. Become part of a wider community of newsrooms, civic organizations, experts, and like-minded groups. Discover opportunities to collaborate, learn from others, and create connections that extend beyond your own chat room.

blocks.text: Muni is more than a place to exchange messages. It’s an opportunity to bring your community closer to your mission and help your organization grow.

blocks.caption: All about MUNI, a platform turning online conversations into real-world action

blocks.text: Before joining your organization’s chat room as a moderator, make sure your profile is ready!

items: Use your real name. We encourage all moderators and members of partner organizations to use their real names. Muni is built around real people having meaningful conversations, and using your real name helps build trust, familiarity, and accountability within the community.
Add a profile photo. Adding a profile photo is optional but highly encouraged! It helps other members recognize you and makes interactions feel more personal.
Follow the recommended name format. For moderators and members representing partner organizations, we encourage using this format for your display name:

blocks.text: Name – Organization
Example: Juan Dela Cruz – ABC Foundation
This helps other members easily identify who they’re talking to and which organization they represent.
Muni gives your organization the tools to create, manage, and nurture your own community. Here’s a look at the features that can help you make the most of your space.

Muni brings together different communities, organizations, and individuals through dedicated chat rooms within the Rappler app. Explore spaces covering news, public affairs, education, local initiatives, and various advocacies, and find conversations and communities that interest you.
If you want to use MUNI, we invite you to download the Rappler app and join MUNI there.
If you’re an organization who wants to have a chat room on MUNI, whether public or private, you can email community@rappler.com.
See you on MUNI!
